title: Distinct neural patterns of valence and arousal in the developing brain: A representational similarity analysis of MEG.
summary: How children and adolescents encode the affective meaning of visual stimuli remains poorly understood. A key reason is that valence and arousal are inherently correlated across affective stimuli and thus confounded in the categorical contrasts mostly used in emotion research. Here, in a secondary analysis of a previously collected MEG dataset, we dissociate the contributions of valence and arousal in emotional processing by applying partial representational similarity analysis (RSA) to magnetoencephalography (MEG) data from 57 typically developing children and adolescents (5 - 18 years old) viewing pictures from the Nencki Affective Picture System. Source-localized responses were first estimated on a volumetric grid, after which we tested, across regions and time windows, whether similarity in neural activity patterns tracked similarity in valence or arousal ratings while controlling for their shared variance. Valence emerged as the primary organizing dimension of neural representations in this sample, with effects detectable in frontotemporal and salience regions within the first 100 ms and sustained over time in the lateral prefrontal cortex. These responses formed a distributed representational network that progressively engaged higher-order evaluative regions. In contrast, arousal contributed transiently through a distinct network that only intermittently overlapped with valence-related activity. Together, these findings indicate that valence predominantly structures affective representations in this pediatric sample, whereas arousal exerts a weaker and more limited influence. This work provides an initial characterization of affective representational structure in this sample of children and adolescents, that if replicated, may inform future reference framework for identifying deviations associated with conditions such as autism spectrum disorder.

标题：发展中的大脑中效价与唤醒的独特神经模式：基于MEG的表征相似性分析
摘要：儿童和青少年如何编码视觉刺激的情感意义仍知之甚少。一个关键原因在于，效价与唤醒在情感刺激中本质上是相关的，因此在情绪研究中常用的类别对比中存在混淆。本研究对先前采集的MEG数据集进行二次分析，通过对57名典型发育儿童和青少年（5-18岁）观看Nencki情感图片系统图片时的脑磁图数据应用偏表征相似性分析（RSA），分离效价与唤醒在情绪加工中的贡献。首先在体积网格上估计源定位响应，随后在跨区域和时间窗中检验神经活动模式的相似性是否追踪效价或唤醒评分的相似性，同时控制二者的共享方差。效价成为该样本中神经表征的主要组织维度，其效应可在前100毫秒内于额颞区和显著性区域检测到，并在外侧前额叶皮层中随时间持续存在。这些响应形成了一个分布式表征网络，逐步招募更高阶的评估区域。相比之下，唤醒通过一个独特的网络短暂发挥作用，该网络仅间歇性地与效价相关活动重叠。总之，这些发现表明，在该儿童样本中效价主要构建情感表征，而唤醒的影响较弱且更为有限。本研究对该儿童和青少年样本的情感表征结构进行了初步刻画，若得以重复，可能为未来识别与自闭症谱系障碍等状况相关的偏差提供参考框架。
关键词：效价；唤醒；情绪加工；表征相似性分析；脑磁图

title: Subjective emotional ratings dissociate brain activation and network patterns during counterfactual outcome processing.
summary: Human decision-making integrates outcome evaluation, counterfactual comparison, and individual traits. We investigated the neural processing of outcome-related emotions during economic decision-making by classifying feedback according to participants' subjective emotional ratings rather than objective gain-loss categories. Participants completed a Wheel of Fortune gambling task during fMRI scanning and provided emotional ratings for feedback outcomes, enabling identification of regret, relief, disappointment, and elation. We also assessed individual differences in regret proneness, maximization tendencies, alternative search, high standards, and decision difficulty. Behaviorally, emotional ratings increased with larger obtained outcomes and decreased as reference outcomes increased, indicating robust modulation of outcome evaluation by counterfactual information Whole-brain analyses revealed greater activation for low-rating than high-rating outcomes, indicating stronger neural responses to negative than positive emotions across feedback types. Complete feedback also elicited greater activation than partial feedback within the same emotional valence. Network-level analyses revealed partially dissociable neural profiles for positive and negative emotions. Positive emotions, including elation and relief, predominantly recruited the somatomotor network, whereas negative emotions, including disappointment and regret, engaged broader distributions across the default mode, dorsal attention, and other large-scale networks. Regret elicited the largest activation extent, whereas elation elicited the smallest. Region-of-interest analyses showed that bilateral orbitofrontal cortex (OFC) responses were significantly greater for negative than positive emotions and for complete than partial feedback conditions. Across all four emotions, right OFC activation was negatively associated with maximization. For elation, relief, and disappointment, right OFC activation was also negatively associated with alternative search and decision difficulty, whereas these associations were absent for regret. Together, these findings demonstrate that subjective emotional evaluation, counterfactual context, and decision-related traits jointly shape the neural processing of decision outcomes, while suggesting relatively trait-independent neural processing of regret.

标题：主观情绪评分分离反事实结果加工中的脑激活与网络模式
摘要：人类决策整合了结果评估、反事实比较和个体特质。本研究通过根据参与者的主观情绪评分而非客观得失类别对反馈进行分类，考察经济决策中结果相关情绪的神经加工。参与者在fMRI扫描期间完成命运之轮赌博任务，并对反馈结果提供情绪评分，从而识别后悔、宽慰、失望和欣喜。我们还评估了后悔倾向、最大化倾向、替代搜索、高标准和决策困难方面的个体差异。在行为层面，情绪评分随所得结果增大而升高，并随参照结果增大而降低，表明反事实信息对结果评估具有稳健的调节作用。全脑分析显示，低评分结果比高评分结果引发更强激活，表明跨反馈类型对负性情绪的神经反应强于正性情绪。在相同情绪效价内，完整反馈也比部分反馈引发更强激活。网络水平分析显示，正性与负性情绪具有部分可分离的神经 profiles。正性情绪（包括欣喜和宽慰）主要招募躯体运动网络，而负性情绪（包括失望和后悔）则更广泛地涉及默认模式、背侧注意及其他大规模网络。后悔引发最大范围的激活，而欣喜引发最小范围的激活。感兴趣区分析显示，双侧眶额皮层（OFC）对负性情绪的反应显著强于正性情绪，对完整反馈条件的反应显著强于部分反馈条件。在所有四种情绪中，右侧OFC激活与最大化呈负相关。对于欣喜、宽慰和失望，右侧OFC激活还与替代搜索和决策困难呈负相关，而后悔则不存在这些关联。总之，这些发现表明，主观情绪评估、反事实情境和决策相关特质共同塑造决策结果的神经加工，同时提示后悔的神经加工相对独立于特质。
关键词：情绪评分；反事实加工；眶额皮层；决策；个体差异

title: Relationships between speech-in-noise comprehension, lip reading ability and cortical speech tracking in talking avatars as well as natural talking heads.
summary: In noisy listening environments, visual cues from a speaker's face can significantly boost speech comprehension. The underlying audiovisual integration in the brain involves tracking of audiovisual speech features in the temporal lobe. Moreover, lip reading in silence is associated with tracking of the speech envelope in the low-delta frequency band (0.5-1 Hz). Recently, digital avatars have emerged that can support speech comprehension. Yet, it remains unclear how the human brain integrates such artificial visual signals with natural speech. Here, we employed magnetoencephalography (MEG) to measure the neural responses to a natural video, an avatar generated by deep neural networks, and a degraded video serving as a control. We demonstrate that the avatar can enhance speech-in-noise comprehension to a similar degree as the degraded video, although less than the natural video. We further identify a late response at 600 ms of the neural tracking in the high delta band (1-4 Hz) that predicts audiovisual speech comprehension. In contrast, we did not find the neural tracking in the theta band to be involved in audiovisual integration. Interestingly, we further found that neural tracking in the low delta band was related to silent lip-reading performance. Moreover, the tracking in the low delta band evoked by the avatars was much weaker and occurred earlier than that elicited by the other audiovisual stimuli. Our results show that audiovisual integration can take place even later than suggested in previous work and can index speech understanding. Additionally, the low delta band and the high delta band play distinct roles in visual-only and audiovisual speech processing, suggesting potential avenues for further boosting the abilities of avatars to support speech comprehension.

标题：在对话头像与自然说话人头部中，噪声下言语理解、唇读能力与皮层言语追踪之间的关系
摘要：在嘈杂的聆听环境中，说话者面部的视觉线索能够显著提升言语理解能力。大脑中潜在的视听整合涉及颞叶对 audiovisual 言语特征的追踪。此外，安静条件下的唇读与低 delta 频段（0.5–1 Hz）言语包络的追踪相关。近年来，能够辅助言语理解的数字头像（digital avatars）已经出现。然而，人脑如何将此类人工视觉信号与自然言语进行整合仍不清楚。本研究采用脑磁图（MEG）测量神经反应，刺激包括自然视频、由深度神经网络生成的头像以及作为对照的退化视频。我们发现，头像能够提升噪声下言语理解，其程度与退化视频相当，但低于自然视频。我们进一步识别出高 delta 频段（1–4 Hz）神经追踪在 600 ms 处的晚期反应，该反应可预测视听言语理解。相反，我们未发现 theta 频段的神经追踪参与视听整合。有趣的是，我们进一步发现低 delta 频段的神经追踪与安静唇读表现相关。此外，头像所诱发的低 delta 频段追踪远弱于其他视听刺激，且出现时间更早。我们的结果表明，视听整合发生的时间可以晚于既往研究所提示的时间，并且能够索引言语理解。此外，低 delta 频段与高 delta 频段在纯视觉与视听言语加工中发挥不同作用，这提示了进一步增强头像辅助言语理解能力的潜在途径。
关键词：视听整合；言语理解；唇读；脑磁图；神经追踪

title: Nucleus accumbens oxytocin modulates avoidance-related behaviors following social isolation in prairie voles.
summary: Chronic social isolation and loneliness are associated with several neuropsychiatric disorders including depression and anxiety. Given its ability to modulate a wide range of processes linked to social interactions, the therapeutic potential of the neuropeptide oxytocin has gathered interest. However, its effects are highly context-dependent, highlighting the need for preclinical models that better capture the breadth of human social interactions and the consequences of their loss. The socially monogamous prairie vole carries a high translational value due to its ability to form enduring social attachments. Here, we aimed at characterizing the role of the oxytocin neurotransmission in the nucleus accumbens (NAc) in the negative consequences of social isolation in prairie voles. Following six weeks of isolation, females exhibited an avoidance of the open arms of an elevated plus maze EPM), lower NAc oxytocin receptor (OXTR) expression, and reduced activation of oxytocin neurons in the paraventricular nucleus of the hypothalamus (PVN) that project to the NAc. Using a combination of site- and projection-specific pharmacological and chemogenetic approaches, we show that the activation of oxytocin neurotransmission in the NAc originating from the PVN reverses the avoidance-related behaviors in the EPM induced by isolation in an OXTR-dependent manner, whereas its blockade promotes avoidance-related behaviors in group-housed control females. Altogether, our findings delineate a model in which the promotion of avoidance-related behaviors following social isolation in female prairie voles is mediated by a dampened response of PVN-to-NAc oxytocin projections, providing additional insights into the negative consequences of social isolation associated with anxiety disorders.

标题：伏隔核催产素调节草原田鼠社会隔离后的回避相关行为
摘要：长期社会隔离与孤独感与包括抑郁和焦虑在内的多种神经精神障碍相关。鉴于催产素能调节与社交互动相关的广泛过程，其治疗潜力已引起关注。然而，催产素的作用高度依赖情境，这凸显了需要能更好捕捉人类社会互动全貌及其丧失后果的临床前模型。社会单配制的草原田鼠因其能够形成持久的社会依恋而具有较高的转化价值。本研究旨在表征伏隔核（NAc）中催产素神经传递在草原田鼠社会隔离负面后果中的作用。经过六周隔离后，雌性田鼠表现出在高架十字迷宫（EPM）中回避开放臂、NAc中催产素受体（OXTR）表达降低，以及下丘脑室旁核（PVN）中投射至NAc的催产素神经元激活减少。通过结合位点和投射特异性的药理学与化学遗传学方法，我们证明激活来源于PVN并投射至NAc的催产素神经传递，能以OXTR依赖的方式逆转隔离诱导的EPM回避相关行为，而其阻断则促进群养对照雌性田鼠的回避相关行为。总之，我们的发现勾勒出一个模型：雌性草原田鼠社会隔离后回避相关行为的促进是由PVN至NAc催产素投射反应减弱所介导的，这为理解社会隔离与焦虑障碍相关的负面后果提供了新的见解。
关键词：社会隔离；催产素；伏隔核；回避行为；草原田鼠

title: TRPA1 antagonism reveals sex-specific mechanisms in morphine withdrawal-induced negative emotional behavior via dopaminergic pathway.
summary: Chronic opioid use facilitates changes in brain reward and affective systems. Cessation of opioid use induces negative affective states characterized by increased anxiety- and despair-like behaviors. In this study, the potential role of transient receptor potential ankyrin 1 channel (TRPA1) was assessed in morphine-induced dependence and negative emotional behaviors. Male and female C57BL/6J mice were exposed to escalating doses of morphine to induce dependence. Naloxone was administered to precipitate withdrawal symptoms. TRPA1 antagonism with A967079 treatment reduced withdrawal syndrome in both male and female mice. After 5 days of abstinence, mice were pre-treated with A967079 before behavioral tests to assess exploratory or anxiety-related, sociability, and despair-like behaviors induced by morphine withdrawal. We found a sex-specific effect of TRPA1 antagonism in different phases of addiction. For example, TRPA1 antagonism reduced withdrawal symptoms and immobility time during the tail suspension test. In contrast, only female mice showed improved sociability during the social interaction test. Additionally, enhanced immobility was observed in both sexes induced by A967079 treatment during the elevated plus maze. Additionally, involvement of the mesolimbic dopaminergic system was discovered to be sex- and brain region-specific in morphine withdrawal and abstinence, highlighting the importance of D2DR in modulating despair-like behavior via TRPA1 antagonism. Collectively, these results suggest that TRPA1 may modulate morphine dependence and negative affective states in a sex-dependent manner.

标题：TRPA1拮抗通过多巴胺能通路揭示吗啡戒断诱导的负性情绪行为的性别特异性机制
摘要：慢性阿片类药物使用促进大脑奖赏和情感系统的改变。停止阿片类药物使用会诱导以焦虑和绝望样行为增加为特征的负性情感状态。本研究评估了瞬时受体电位锚蛋白1通道（TRPA1）在吗啡诱导的依赖和负性情绪行为中的潜在作用。雄性和雌性C57BL/6J小鼠接受递增剂量的吗啡以诱导依赖。给予纳洛酮以催发戒断症状。使用A967079进行TRPA1拮抗可减轻雄性和雌性小鼠的戒断综合征。戒断5天后，小鼠在行为测试前接受A967079预处理，以评估吗啡戒断诱导的探索性或焦虑相关行为、社交性和绝望样行为。我们发现TRPA1拮抗在成瘾不同阶段具有性别特异性效应。例如，TRPA1拮抗减少了戒断症状和悬尾测试中的不动时间。相反，仅在雌性小鼠中观察到社会互动测试中社交性的改善。此外，在A967079处理下，高架十字迷宫测试中两种性别均观察到不动时间增加。此外，研究发现中脑边缘多巴胺能系统参与吗啡戒断和戒断后禁欲期，且具有性别和脑区特异性，突出了D2DR在通过TRPA1拮抗调节绝望样行为中的重要性。总之，这些结果表明TRPA1可能以性别依赖的方式调节吗啡依赖和负性情感状态。
关键词：TRPA1；吗啡戒断；负性情绪；性别差异；多巴胺能系统

title: Alexithymia and affective symptoms: A construct level evaluation of the emotion regulation pathway in a community sample with self-reported psychiatric history.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Alexithymia has been proposed as a potential risk/vulnerability factor for affective disorder symptoms, but the processes accounting for this association require further specification. Preece et al. (2022) reported that emotion regulation difficulties statistically mediated the alexithymia-affective symptom association in a U.S. community sample (N = 501). Independent replication across alternative measures and in clinical and clinically enriched community samples is needed.
METHOD: In a community sample of 661 U.S. adults (28.6% reporting at least one lifetime psychiatric diagnosis; 41% reporting a history of mental health treatment), we conducted a conceptual and extended replication of the Preece et al. (2022) model with the Perth Alexithymia Questionnaire (PAQ), Perth Emotion Regulation Competency Inventory (PERCI), and Depression Anxiety Stress Scales-21 (DASS-21), and tested three additional models substituting the 20-item Toronto Alexithymia Scale (TAS-20) for the PAQ and the Difficulties in Emotion Regulation Scale (DERS) for the PERCI in a fully crossed design. Sensitivity analyses re-estimated the DERS-based models with a "purified" DERS excluding the Awareness and Clarity subscales.
RESULTS: Standardized indirect effects were similar for both PERCI-based models (β = 0.32-0.34) and notably larger for both full-DERS models (β = 0.50-0.51). When the DERS Awareness and Clarity subscales were excluded, the standardized indirect effects in the purified-DERS models fell to β = 0.33-0.34, converging with the PERCI-based estimates. The pattern was preserved with depression, anxiety, and stress subscales examined separately, and within the lifetime-diagnosis subsample.
LIMITATIONS: The data are cross-sectional and rely on self-report, with associated risk of common-method variance.
CONCLUSIONS: When shared item content between alexithymia and emotion regulation measures is minimized, the standardized indirect effect of alexithymia on affective symptoms through emotion regulation difficulties converges around β ≈ 0.33 across the two alexithymia operationalizations and both emotion regulation instruments. This pattern is consistent with, but does not establish, the hypothesized ordering in which alexithymia relates to affective symptoms through emotion regulation difficulties, and the robustness across operationalizations should not be interpreted as adjudicating between the original, affect-deficit and attention-appraisal models of alexithymia.

标题：述情障碍与情感症状：在自我报告精神病史的社区样本中对情绪调节通路的构念水平评估
摘要：背景：述情障碍已被提出作为情感障碍症状的潜在风险/易感因素，但解释这一关联的过程仍需进一步明确。Preece等（2022）报告，在一个美国社区样本（N=501）中，情绪调节困难在述情障碍与情感症状关联中起统计中介作用。需要在替代测量工具以及临床和临床富集的社区样本中进行独立重复验证。方法：在一个由661名美国成年人组成的社区样本中（28.6%报告至少一种终生精神科诊断；41%报告有心理健康治疗史），我们使用珀斯述情障碍问卷（PAQ）、珀斯情绪调节能力量表（PERCI）和抑郁焦虑压力量表-21（DASS-21）对Preece等（2022）模型进行了概念性及扩展性重复验证，并在完全交叉设计中检验了另外三个模型，分别以20条目多伦多述情障碍量表（TAS-20）替代PAQ、以情绪调节困难量表（DERS）替代PERCI。敏感性分析使用排除 Awareness 和 Clarity 分量表的“纯化”DERS重新估计基于DERS的模型。结果：基于PERCI的两个模型标准化间接效应相似（β=0.32-0.34），而两个完整DERS模型的间接效应明显更大（β=0.50-0.51）。当排除DERS的Awareness和Clarity分量表后，纯化DERS模型中的标准化间接效应降至β=0.33-0.34，与基于PERCI的估计收敛。分别考察抑郁、焦虑和压力分量表以及在终生诊断子样本中，该模式均得以保持。局限性：数据为横断面且依赖自我报告，存在共同方法偏差的相关风险。结论：当述情障碍与情绪调节测量之间的共享条目内容被最小化时，述情障碍通过情绪调节困难对情感症状的标准化间接效应在两种述情障碍操作化和两种情绪调节工具之间收敛于β≈0.33。该模式与“述情障碍通过情绪调节困难与情感症状相关”的假设顺序一致，但并不能确立该顺序，且跨操作化的一致性不应被解释为对述情障碍原始模型、情感缺陷模型和注意-评价模型的裁决。
关键词：述情障碍；情绪调节；情感症状；中介效应；社区样本

title: Mind-wandering content in major depressive disorder: A preregistered secondary analysis.
summary: Individuals with Major Depressive Disorder (MDD) experience high levels of mind-wandering. Despite the fact that mind wandering is common, there is a need to better characterize its occurrence beyond mere frequency. In our preregistered study we aimed to characterize the thematic content and valence of on- and off-task thoughts and examine whether they differ based on MDD status. Adults diagnosed with MDD (n = 53) and healthy controls (n = 53) completed an in-person continuous performance task with random probes to assess their thoughts. Participants indicated whether their thoughts were on-task or, if they were off-task, the thematic content of their thoughts. They also rated the valence (negative to positive) of their thoughts. Compared to controls, individuals with MDD reported higher levels of mind wandering overall. When looking at specific thought contents, the only difference occurred for mind wandering about personally relevant worries (and this remained after excluding individuals with comorbid anxiety disorders). Both groups rated mind-wandering thoughts as being more negative than on-task thoughts to a similar degree. This work clarifies qualitative aspects of the mind-wandering process that differs between adults with MDD and healthy controls. Findings indicate that personally relevant concerns may drive the increased frequency of mind-wandering in MDD. In contrast, neither frequencies of other specific content areas nor the extent to which mind-wandering versus on-task thoughts are negative differed by MDD status. Future studies should test whether targeting worry-centric spontaneous thoughts alleviates cognitive symptoms of MDD to a greater degree than focusing on reducing mind-wandering broadly in treating MDD.

标题：重性抑郁障碍中的走神内容：一项预注册的二次分析
摘要：重性抑郁障碍（MDD）个体经历高水平的走神。尽管走神现象普遍存在，但仍需要超越单纯的频率来更好地刻画其发生特征。在本预注册研究中，我们旨在刻画任务中与任务外思维的主题内容和效价，并检验其是否因MDD状态而存在差异。被诊断为MDD的成年人（n=53）和健康对照（n=53）完成了一项面对面的持续注意任务，并通过随机探针评估其思维。参与者报告其思维是否在任务上，若不在任务上，则报告思维的主题内容。他们还对思维的效价（从消极到积极）进行评分。与对照组相比，MDD个体报告的整体走神水平更高。在考察具体思维内容时，唯一差异出现在与个人相关担忧有关的走神上（排除共病焦虑障碍个体后该差异仍然存在）。两组均将走神思维评定为比任务中思维更消极，且程度相似。本研究阐明了MDD成年人与健康对照之间走神过程存在差异的定性方面。研究发现表明，与个人相关的担忧可能驱动了MDD中走神频率的增加。相比之下，其他具体内容领域的频率以及走神思维相对于任务中思维的消极程度均不因MDD状态而不同。未来研究应检验，在MDD治疗中，针对以担忧为中心的自发思维是否比广泛减少走神更能缓解MDD的认知症状。
关键词：重性抑郁障碍；走神；思维内容；效价；担忧

title: Resting-state functional connectivity and alexithymia: Preliminary predictive evidence.
summary: Alexithymia, defined by reduced emotional awareness, is prevalent in psychiatric and substance use disorders; however, its relationship with brain circuitry remains insufficiently understood. Investigating alexithymia in healthy adults enables identification of core brain networks underlying disrupted emotional awareness, independent of comorbid pathology, and may inform the development of targeted interventions. In this study, 150 healthy individuals were assessed using the Toronto Alexithymia Scale (TAS-20) and underwent resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging. Predictive modeling was applied to whole-brain functional connectivity data to identify network patterns predictive of individual differences in alexithymia. Distinct brain patterns emerged for the TAS-20 total score and the Difficulty Describing Feelings (DDF) subscale. For total alexithymia, the right thalamus and left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (dlPFC) were implicated. Higher total alexithymia was associated with reduced connectivity between the thalamus and posterior insula and sensorimotor regions, as well as decreased connectivity between the dlPFC and the cerebellum, medial temporal lobe, and frontal cortex. For the DDF subscale, the left premotor cortex (PMC) was identified as a central node, with higher DDF scores linked to reduced connectivity between the left PMC and both the anterior insula and dorsal anterior cingulate cortex. Overall, decreased connectivity among sensory integration, cognitive control, and motor planning networks modestly predicted core features of alexithymia. These findings provide preliminary evidence for the neural networks underlying individual differences in emotional processing and provide a framework for future research on vulnerability to psychiatric disorders and the development of targeted, circuit-based interventions.

标题：静息态功能连接与述情障碍：初步预测性证据
摘要：述情障碍以情绪觉察能力降低为特征，在精神疾病和物质使用障碍中较为普遍；然而，其与脑回路之间的关系仍未被充分理解。在健康成人中研究述情障碍，有助于识别情绪觉察受损背后的核心脑网络，且不受共病病理的干扰，并可能为开发针对性干预措施提供依据。本研究对150名健康个体施测多伦多述情障碍量表（TAS-20）并进行静息态功能磁共振成像。研究采用预测建模方法分析全脑功能连接数据，以识别可预测述情障碍个体差异的网络模式。TAS-20总分与难以描述感受（DDF）分量表呈现出不同的脑模式。对于述情障碍总分，右侧丘脑和左侧背外侧前额叶皮层（dlPFC）被牵涉其中。较高的述情障碍总分与丘脑和后岛叶及感觉运动区域之间连接减弱相关，也与dlPFC与小脑、内侧颞叶及额叶皮层之间连接减弱相关。对于DDF分量表，左侧前运动皮层（PMC）被确定为中枢节点，较高的DDF得分与左侧PMC和前岛叶及背侧前扣带皮层之间连接减弱相关。总体而言，感觉整合、认知控制和运动规划网络之间连接的减弱可适度预测述情障碍的核心特征。这些发现为情绪加工个体差异背后的神经网络提供了初步证据，并为未来研究精神疾病易感性及开发针对性的、基于回路的干预措施提供了框架。
关键词：述情障碍；静息态功能连接；情绪觉察；预测建模；背外侧前额叶皮层

title: Identifying coping strategies that regulate negative climate emotions without reducing pro-environmental behavior.
summary: Negative climate emotions may represent both a psychological burden and a motivator for pro-environmental behavior (PEB). Identifying coping strategies that reduce distress without undermining engagement is therefore crucial. In this preregistered online experiment (N = 313), negative climate emotions were induced via film and participants were randomized to meaning-focused coping (MFC), emotional acceptance, or cognitive distraction. Negative and positive affect were assessed before and after coping, and PEB was measured using a fully incentivized behavioral task involving real time and effort costs. All coping strategies reduced negative affect, with distraction producing the strongest short-term reduction. Higher post-coping negative affect predicted greater odds of WEPT engagement. Importantly, participants in the MFC condition showed a higher likelihood of engaging in PEB compared to acceptance and distraction, and these differences persisted after statistical adjustment for post-coping negative affect. Exploratory analyses further indicated that MFC increased positive affect relative to the other strategies, consistent with theoretical accounts proposing that meaning-focused coping can generate positive emotions that support sustained engagement. Trait climate change distress predicted both state negative affect and PEB, but did not moderate the association between affect and behavior. These findings suggest that while distraction may be effective for short-term affect reduction, meaning-focused coping may better sustain behavioral engagement in the context of negative climate emotions.

标题：识别能够调节负面气候情绪而不减少亲环境行为的应对策略
摘要：负面气候情绪既可能构成心理负担，也可能成为亲环境行为（PEB）的动机。因此，识别能够在不削弱参与意愿的前提下缓解痛苦的应对策略至关重要。在本预注册在线实验中（N = 313），通过影片诱发负面气候情绪，并将参与者随机分配至意义聚焦应对（MFC）、情绪接纳或认知分心三种条件。在应对前后评估负性与正性情绪，并采用完全激励化的行为任务测量PEB，该任务涉及真实的时间与努力成本。所有应对策略均降低了负性情绪，其中分心策略的短期降低效果最强。应对后较高的负性情绪预测了更高的WEPT参与几率。重要的是，与接纳和分心条件相比，MFC条件下的参与者表现出更高的PEB参与可能性，且在统计调整应对后负性情绪后这些差异仍然存在。探索性分析进一步表明，相对于其他策略，MFC增加了正性情绪，这与意义聚焦应对能够产生支持持续参与的正性情绪的理论解释一致。特质性气候变化痛苦同时预测了状态负性情绪和PEB，但未调节情绪与行为之间的关联。这些发现表明，尽管分心可能有效实现短期情绪缓解，但意义聚焦应对可能更有助于在负面气候情绪背景下维持行为参与。
关键词：气候情绪；应对策略；亲环境行为；意义聚焦应对；情绪调节

title: Trait emotion regulation mediates the protective role of resting-state brain activity against depressive symptoms in late adolescence.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Depression is a common psychiatric condition posing serious threats to individual physical and mental health. While previous studies have demonstrated that trait emotion regulation (TER) is a protective factor for depression, the neural correlates between TER and depression remain unclear, especially in adolescents. This study aimed to investigate the neurofunctional substrates of TER and its neural link to depressive symptoms in adolescents.
METHODS: Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging and a battery of behavioral assessments were administered to 231 general high school students. Whole-brain correlation analyses and prediction analyses were conducted to identify brain regions whose fractional amplitude of low-frequency fluctuations (fALFF) was associated with TER. We examined the correlation between the activity of identified brain regions and depressive symptoms, and conducted mediation analyses to explore the role of TER in mediating the brain-depression relationship.
RESULTS: TER was significantly correlated negatively with fALFF in the ventromedial prefrontal cortex (VMPFC), and positively with fALFF in the cuneus. Depressive symptoms were negatively correlated with TER, and positively with fALFF in the VMPFC. In mediation analysis, TER had a significant indirect effect on the relationship between the VMPFC activity and depressive symptoms.
CONCLUSIONS: These results reveal the brain functional basis of TER at rest, and identify a neuropsychological pathway through which TER may help ameliorate depression. Our study may provide novel neurobiological insights for early interventions targeting adolescent depression.

标题：特质情绪调节在青春期晚期静息态脑活动对抑郁症状的保护作用中起中介作用
摘要：背景：抑郁是一种常见的精神疾病，对个体身心健康构成严重威胁。尽管既往研究表明特质情绪调节（TER）是抑郁的保护因素，但TER与抑郁之间的神经关联仍不清楚，尤其是在青少年群体中。本研究旨在探讨青少年TER的神经功能基础及其与抑郁症状的神经联系。方法：对231名普通高中学生进行静息态功能磁共振成像及一系列行为评估。通过全脑相关分析和预测分析，识别低频波动分数幅值（fALFF）与TER相关的脑区。我们检验了所识别脑区活动与抑郁症状之间的相关性，并进行中介分析以探究TER在脑-抑郁关系中的中介作用。结果：TER与腹内侧前额叶皮层（VMPFC）的fALFF呈显著负相关，与楔叶的fALFF呈正相关。抑郁症状与TER呈负相关，与VMPFC的fALFF呈正相关。在中介分析中，TER对VMPFC活动与抑郁症状之间的关系具有显著的间接效应。结论：这些结果揭示了TER在静息状态下的脑功能基础，并识别了一条TER可能有助于改善抑郁的神经心理通路。本研究可能为针对青少年抑郁的早期干预提供新的神经生物学见解。
关键词：特质情绪调节；抑郁症状；静息态功能磁共振成像；腹内侧前额叶皮层；中介作用

title: Big Five personality dimensions and their association with depressive symptom severity over the treatment course.
summary: Personality traits and depressive symptoms are closely related, yet their coordinated change during treatment remains insufficiently understood. We examined change in Big Five scores and depression during inpatient care and tested whether personality trait expression was associated with symptom-specific depressive change. In this naturalistic study, 334 inpatients with affective or psychotic disorders at a German University Hospital completed Beck Depression Inventory and Big Five Inventory-2-XS across three to five assessments. Coordinated change in depression severity and personality scores was examined using bivariate latent growth models. To capture symptom-level heterogeneity, proportional-odds ordinal mixed-effects models were fitted for each BDI item using average personality scores across treatment as moderators. Depression severity decreased over treatment. Growth models showed coordinated change between depression and several personality trait scores: reductions in Neuroticism and increases in Agreeableness, Conscientiousness, and Extraversion were associated with greater reductions in depression severity. At the symptom level, higher average Neuroticism was associated with slower improvement across a broad range of affective, cognitive, somatic, and functioning-related symptoms. Higher average Agreeableness and Extraversion were associated with faster improvement in selected symptoms, while Openness showed limited symptom-specific associations and Conscientiousness showed no significant moderation effects. Self-reported personality trait scores and depression show coordinated change during inpatient treatment. Symptom-level analyses suggest that depressive symptom trajectories differ according to average personality trait expression across treatment. These findings highlight the potential value of integrating personality assessment with symptom-level monitoring, while underscoring that the observed associations are non-causal and should not be interpreted as baseline prediction.

标题：大五人格维度及其与治疗过程中抑郁症状严重程度的关联
摘要：人格特质与抑郁症状密切相关，但二者在治疗过程中的协同变化仍缺乏充分理解。本研究考察了住院治疗期间大五人格得分与抑郁的变化，并检验人格特质表达是否与症状特异性的抑郁变化相关。在这项自然主义研究中，德国一所大学医院的334名情感性或精神病性障碍住院患者完成了三轮至五轮贝克抑郁量表和大五人格量表-2-XS评估。采用双变量潜变量增长模型考察抑郁严重程度与人格得分的协同变化。为捕捉症状层面的异质性，以治疗期间的平均人格得分作为调节变量，对每个BDI条目拟合比例优势序数混合效应模型。抑郁严重程度在治疗过程中下降。增长模型显示，抑郁与若干人格特质得分之间存在协同变化：神经质减少以及宜人性、尽责性和外向性增加与抑郁严重程度更大幅度的下降相关。在症状层面，较高的平均神经质与广泛的情感、认知、躯体及功能相关症状的较慢改善相关。较高的平均宜人性与外向性与部分症状的较快改善相关，而开放性显示有限的症状特异性关联，尽责性未显示显著的调节效应。自我报告的人格特质得分与抑郁在住院治疗期间表现出协同变化。症状层面分析提示，抑郁症状轨迹因治疗期间的平均人格特质表达而异。这些发现凸显了将人格评估与症状层面监测相结合的可能价值，同时强调所观察到的关联并非因果性，不应被解释为基线预测。
关键词：大五人格；抑郁症状；住院治疗；潜变量增长模型；症状异质性

title: Structural Brain Network Alterations in Relation to Treatment and Illness Severity in Bipolar Disorder.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Large-scale T1-weighted magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) studies have established gray matter abnormalities in bipolar disorder (BD), with our group contributing to consensus findings. However, structural connectivity, particularly within emotion- and reward-related circuits, remains poorly understood. Diffusion-weighted MRI (dMRI) enables investigation of white matter pathways, but prior work is constrained by small samples, methodological heterogeneity, and unclear medication effects. We conducted the largest dMRI network analysis in BD, relating symptom burden and polypharmacy to tractography-derived connectivity and graph-theoretical metrics.
METHODS: Cross-sectional structural and diffusion MRI scans from 450 individuals with BD (mean ± SD = 35.7 ± 12.6 years) and 509 control participants (33.3 ± 12.6 years), ages 18 to 65 years, were analyzed across 16 ENIGMA (Enhancing Neuro Imaging Genetics through Meta Analysis) BD sites. Standardized segmentation/parcellation and constrained spherical deconvolution tractography generated individual structural connectivity matrices. Graph-theoretical metrics of global and subnetwork organization were related to symptom severity and medications.
RESULTS: BD showed widespread network alterations (lower density and efficiency, longer path length, and higher betweenness centrality), altered microstructural organization in a limbic-basal ganglia circuit, and abnormal streamline counts in a default mode/salience/frontolimbic-basal ganglia network. Longer illness duration, later onset, and psychosis history were associated with greater abnormalities in network architecture, whereas more manic episodes were associated with greater frontolimbic connectivity. Antidepressant (particularly selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor), anticonvulsant, and antipsychotic use related to poorer global and frontolimbic connectivity; no clear lithium effects emerged.
CONCLUSIONS: As the largest structural connectivity study in BD, we revealed widespread disruption in reward and emotion-regulation networks influenced by illness severity and medication use. Results show that multisite harmonization is feasible and highlight ENIGMA-BD as a scalable framework for identifying reproducible neurobiological markers.

标题：双相情感障碍中与治疗和疾病严重程度相关的结构性脑网络改变
摘要：背景：大规模T1加权磁共振成像（MRI）研究已确认双相情感障碍（BD）存在灰质异常，本课题组亦贡献了一致的共识性发现。然而，结构性连接，尤其是情绪与奖赏相关环路内的结构性连接，仍知之甚少。弥散加权MRI（dMRI）可用于研究白质通路，但既往工作受限于样本量小、方法学异质性及药物效应不明确。我们开展了BD领域规模最大的dMRI网络分析，将症状负担和多药联用与纤维追踪导出的连接及图论指标相关联。方法：分析来自16个ENIGMA-BD站点的450名BD个体（均值±标准差=35.7±12.6岁）和509名对照参与者（33.3±12.6岁）的横断面结构与弥散MRI扫描，年龄18至65岁。采用标准化分割/分区和约束球面反卷积纤维追踪生成个体结构性连接矩阵。将全局和子网络组织的图论指标与症状严重程度及药物相关联。结果：BD表现出广泛的网络改变（密度和效率降低、路径长度延长、介数中心性升高）、边缘-基底节环路微结构组织改变，以及默认模式/突显/额边缘-基底节网络纤维束计数异常。更长的病程、更晚的发病年龄和精神病性症状史与网络结构更大的异常相关，而更多躁狂发作与更大的额边缘连接相关。抗抑郁药（特别是选择性5-羟色胺再摄取抑制剂）、抗惊厥药和抗精神病药的使用与较差的全局和额边缘连接相关；未发现明确的锂盐效应。结论：作为BD领域规模最大的结构性连接研究，我们揭示了受疾病严重程度和药物使用影响的奖赏与情绪调节网络的广泛破坏。结果表明多站点协调是可行的，并凸显ENIGMA-BD作为识别可重复神经生物学标志物的可扩展框架。
关键词：双相情感障碍；结构性连接；情绪调节网络；弥散MRI；图论分析

title: Facilitating Thought Progression: A Neurocognitive Framework Linking Thought Dynamics and Mood Disorders.
summary: Mood and thought are tightly coupled, but the mechanisms that link them are not understood. This link is particularly important when considering mood disorders such as depression. We propose the facilitating thought progression (FTP) framework, which characterizes depression as a disorder of thought dynamics, encompassing both the temporal evolution and semantic expanse of mental activity. Five parameters jointly determine the fluency of thought progression: breadth, speed, flexibility, novelty, and scope. Diminished progression, reflected by repetitive, slow, and narrowed thinking, is associated with excessive inhibition, reduced plasticity, blunted reward signaling, and overly deep attractor dynamics. Conversely, interventions that enhance associative expansion, cognitive flexibility, and exploratory behavior restore adaptive brain dynamics. FTP reframes depression as a disorder of cognitive flow rather than content and provides a mechanistic, testable model for translational research.

标题：促进思维进程：一个连接思维动态与心境障碍的神经认知框架
摘要：心境与思维紧密耦合，但其连接机制尚不清楚。在考虑抑郁等心境障碍时，这一联系尤为重要。我们提出促进思维进程（FTP）框架，该框架将抑郁描述为一种思维动态障碍，涵盖心理活动的时间演变与语义广度。五个参数共同决定思维进程的流畅性：广度、速度、灵活性、新颖性和范围。进程减退表现为重复、缓慢和狭窄的思维，与过度抑制、可塑性降低、奖赏信号减弱以及过深的吸引子动态相关。反之，增强联想扩展、认知灵活性和探索行为的干预可恢复适应性大脑动态。FTP将抑郁重新界定为一种认知流畅性障碍而非内容障碍，并为转化研究提供了一个机制性、可检验的模型。
关键词：思维动态；心境障碍；抑郁；认知流畅性；神经认知框架

title: The Interactional Context of Problem‐, Emotion‐, and Relationship‐Focused Coping: The Role of the Big Five Personality Factors
summary: ABSTRACTThis study examined the role that personality and situational factors play in three forms of coping responses: problem‐, emotion‐ and relationship‐focused. Coping responses were strongly associated with whether the situation involved a primarily agentic (work) or communal (interpersonal) stressor. Among communal stressors, the involvement of close versus distant others was also associated with coping responses. Situational factors were linked most strongly with the use of problem‐focused (planful problem solving) and relationship‐focused (empathic responding) modes of coping. Dimensions of personality derived from the five‐factor model (Neuroticism, Extraversion, Openness to Experience, Agreeableness, and Conscientiousness) had important associations with coping responses. Coping responses were best predicted by models that included both the additive and multiplicative effects of person and situation factors. Taken together, the findings suggest that a model of coping that considers both agentic and communal dimensions of stressful situations, includes interpersonal dimensions of coping, and considers personality and situation factors in tandem is needed to increase the predictive utility of current models.

标题：问题聚焦、情绪聚焦与关系聚焦应对的交互情境：大五人格因素的作用
摘要：本研究考察人格与情境因素在三种应对反应形式中的作用：问题聚焦应对、情绪聚焦应对和关系聚焦应对。应对反应与压力源主要涉及能动性（工作）还是共同体性（人际）情境密切相关。在共同体性压力源中，亲近他人与疏远他人的卷入程度也与应对反应相关。情境因素与问题聚焦应对（有计划的问题解决）和关系聚焦应对（共情反应）的使用关联最强。源自五因素模型的人格维度（神经质、外向性、经验开放性、宜人性和尽责性）与应对反应具有重要关联。同时纳入人与情境因素的加性效应和乘性效应的模型对应对反应的预测效果最佳。综合来看，研究结果表明，需要一个同时考虑压力情境的能动性与共同体性维度、纳入应对的人际维度、并将人格与情境因素结合考察的应对模型，以提升现有模型的预测效用。
关键词：应对方式；大五人格；情境因素；人际应对；压力源
